scope: startup diagnostic, exact Xvfb auth/listen options from failed run, no input; fresh ephemeral cookie not retained
command:
import os,subprocess,time,json
from pathlib import Path
import vizdoom as vd
import secrets,tempfile
f=tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(prefix="xauth-",delete=False);f.close()
subprocess.run(["xauth","-f",f.name,"add",":93","MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1",secrets.token_hex(16)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True)
os.environ["XAUTHORITY"]=f.name
x=subprocess.Popen(["Xvfb",":93","-screen","0","640x480x24","-nolisten","tcp","-nolisten","unix","-auth",f.name],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
os.environ["DISPLAY"]=":93"
time.sleep(.5)
pkg=Path(vd.__file__).resolve().parent
cfg=Path("/tmp/diagnostic-doom.ini");cfg.write_text("[Doom.Bindings]\nw=+forward\n")
a=[str(pkg/"vizdoom"),"-iwad",str(pkg/"freedoom2.wad"),"-config",str(cfg),"-warp","1","-window","-nosound","-nojoy","-width","640","-height","480"]
p=subprocess.Popen(a,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
try:
 try: out,err=p.communicate(timeout=4); disposition="exited"
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: p.terminate();out,err=p.communicate(timeout=3);disposition="terminated_after_4s"
 print(json.dumps({"xvfb_alive":x.poll() is None,"disposition":disposition,"exit":p.returncode,"stdout":out.decode(errors="replace")[-5000:],"stderr":err.decode(errors="replace")[-5000:]}))
finally:
 if p.poll() is None:p.kill();p.wait(timeout=3)
 x.terminate();x.wait(timeout=3)
